datasets.title: Sleep and Dream Database (SDDb), Zenodo snapshot 2025-12-28, version 2
datasets.notes: Record ID, DOI, version, file name and provider MD5 match the Notion Data Registry row and the public Zenodo record page (read 2026-11-24 with an automated page fetch). The SHA-256 pin is the value recorded in the Notion Data Registry for the original CSV, computed locally on a user-supplied copy whose MD5 matched the provider MD5; it has not yet been reproduced by this pipeline's fetch, so the first manual verify-datasets run must confirm it (a mismatch fails the run). Licence (evidence checked 2026-11-24, still Unverified): the Zenodo record page's Rights section lists 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International' (cc-by-4.0). This deposit is a third-party duplicate of the SDDb uploaded by its data curator (Remington Mallett), not by the SDDb itself. The SDDb website (sleepanddreamdatabase.org, directed by Kelly Bulkeley) states '© 2025. Sleep and Dream Database. All Rights Reserved.' The SDDb reports come from many sources (dream journals, surveys, psychology studies, anthropological and historical texts); some sub-collections carry their own terms (DreamBank: attribution required, commercial use prohibited). Whether the uploader could grant CC BY 4.0 for all reports is therefore not established. Until the SDDb (info@sleepanddreamdatabase.org) confirms, treat the file as local-analysis only: no redistribution of reports or derivatives containing text; publish aggregate counts with attribution only. Aggregate structure recorded in Notion for the original CSV (local QA, not a pipeline run): 44,556 rows; 42,989 non-empty dream texts; 1,567 empty; 44,556 distinct Dream Report IDs (0 duplicates); 85 survey names. Participant IDs, two denominators to report separately (Notion audit correction 2026-11-24): 15,880 distinct non-empty IDs across all 44,556 rows; 15,436 distinct non-empty IDs among the 42,989 non-empty narratives, with 144 non-empty narratives lacking an ID. Never commit dream narratives, participant IDs or source keys; reports must stay aggregate-only. Keep report-level dream data separate from study-level Ganzfeld outcomes. A cleaned 14-column derivative (SHA-256 41bac0b6d4a5f1b2a889e4d0a9f1c8459acbe1e1df2ee8e7e0d1dc4644031779) is a separate local artifact, not a Zenodo file, and is not listed here.
